items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia has seen profits soar as unrelenting demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. US-headquartered Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.

items.headline: Lithium miners post big profits as battery storage demand surges
items.snippet: US-headquartered Albemarle Corp. said global lithium demand grew 45% through May from a year earlier, outstripping supply growth. Inventories of the battery material held by industry players in China are declining, suggesting tightness in the market.

items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Could Be 27% Undervalued On Lithium Expansion Plans
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB) is back in focus after the board appointed Max W. Hood as Chief Accounting Officer, shortly after outlining lithium capacity expansion projects tied to electric vehicle and energy storage demand.

items.headline: ALB vs. SQM: Which Lithium Stock Should You Bet on Now?
items.snippet: ALB expects lithium demand to witness a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030. Albemarle expects demand to grow roughly 15-40% this year, with growth already trending near the higher end of the range.

items.headline: Lithium price 'chill' returns, JPMorgan downgrades Albemarle (ALB.US) earnings forecast and cuts target price to $140
items.snippet: Albemarle's Greenbushes CGP3 plant in Australia continues to face delays after a fire in June. JPMorgan believes that Albemarle's current stock price is close to its target price, and the valuation is reasonable for a high-quality but volatile lithium producer.
